recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a man in a crouching pose, centered within a dense, sun-dappled green thicket. The composition features heavy, blocky slab-serif typography anchored at the top, utilizing a high-contrast color palette of yellow and white against the dark foliage.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a frame of organic greenery
Heavy typography balanced against the subject's central vertical axis
Warm skin tones and blue clothing contrasting with cool green shadows
coreInvariants: Dense foliage background with dappled light

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, occupying the middle third of the frame vertically and horizontally, shown in a full-body crouch.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large white slab-serif text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold white text, move down to the subject's face, and follow the diagonal line of the legs toward the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The surrounding foliage acts as textured negative space, framing the subject tightly.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep forest green and olive (background foliage)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white (primary text) and yellow (secondary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the greens and blues with deep, crushed shadows characteristic of 70s film stock.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or synthetic digital colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with heavy rectangular serifs

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the top edge of the foliage

treatment.shadow: Subtle dark drop shadow for legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic typeface family using weight and color to distinguish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serifs and geometric structure.
Classic 70s slab serif with similar weight and presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution photograph of a man in a blue long-sleeve shirt and brown trousers, crouching in the center of a dense, sun-dappled green forest thicket. Use 1970s film aesthetic with rich greens and warm skin tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered uppercase slab-serif text at the top. The top line should be yellow and medium-sized; the bottom line should be white and very large/bold. Use tight leading and tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered at the top?
Is the subject in a full-body crouch?
Does the background consist of dense, textured greenery?
Is the typography a heavy slab serif?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of yellow for the subtitle
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Exact tracklist text below the main title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white text is the most prominent visual element after the subject's face.
Check that the green tones feel organic and deep, not neon.
Verify the crouching pose is stable and centered.
Confirm the slab serifs are thick and rectangular.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central portrait + dense organic texture background + top-weighted heavy slab-serif typography = 1970s vintage editorial aesthetic.
